guide.summary: Partner integration for many customers (partner acceptance); Custom integration in one customer's account (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Custom integration in one customer's account (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Partner integration for many customers (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio lists a managed OAuth app for Greenhouse, which suits prototypes. For launch, create an auth config with your own Greenhouse-issued Client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes, since Composio provides a managed app. For production you likely want your own credentials from Greenhouse, for your branding, dedicated quota and scopes the managed app may not include.
reasons: Consent screen shows Composio, not your brand, with the managed app
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Composio's default scopes may not cover what you need
Production partner access is issued to you by Greenhouse

scenarios.label: Partner integration for many customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent product connects many Greenhouse customers (mutual customers) through your own OAuth client.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from step count, not measured: request form, credentials request, callback setup, testing.

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "About 1-6 weeks").

scenarios.approval: Greenhouse must accept your company into its partner program and you must sign a partnership agreement before credentials are issued. Not every submission is accepted. What the review checks is not documented.

scenarios.label: Custom integration in one customer's account
scenarios.when_this_applies: A customer builds an integration used only within its own Greenhouse account.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from step count, not measured: create credential, pick scopes, connect.

waiting.basis: Credentials are created by the customer in its own account (c25); no provider review is described.

scenarios.approval: No Greenhouse review is described. The customer creates the credentials in its own account.

prerequisites.detail: Greenhouse requires it before the OAuth steps can begin. Start with the integration request form.

steps.title: Submit integration request form
steps.detail: Apply to the Greenhouse partner program with company details.

steps.title: Wait for partner review
steps.detail: Reviews run monthly; expect a reply within 7 business days after. Acceptance is not guaranteed.
steps.done_when: Greenhouse confirms you officially as a partner.

steps.title: Sign partnership agreement
steps.detail: Legal signature is required before credentials are issued.

steps.title: Draft credentials request
steps.detail: Prepare name, environment, scope list and redirect URI. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Request text is ready to send.

steps.title: Send request to Partner Support
steps.detail: Request testing credentials first, then production.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Use your Greenhouse Client ID and secret in a custom OAuth2 auth config for the greenhouse toolkit. Keep the secret confidential.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Tell Greenhouse the final redirect URI
steps.detail: Once the callback works in testing, inform Greenhouse support so production is set up.

steps.title: Create Harvest V3 credential
steps.detail: In Greenhouse API Credentials, create a Harvest V3 (OAuth) credential and select scopes.

traps.title: Refresh tokens last 14 days in Harvest partner integrations
traps.detail: Refresh tokens last 14 days in Harvest partner integrations; if unused for 14 days the user must repeat the authorization flow.

traps.title: Partner integrations, for Greenhouse partners integrating with mutual customers
traps.detail: Partner integrations, for Greenhouse partners integrating with mutual customers, must use the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow.

traps.title: Partner acceptance can be refused
traps.detail: Submitting does not guarantee acceptance, and reviews run only monthly. Out-of-cycle review is generally only for urgent requests from a mutual customer.

traps.title: Short-lived tokens
traps.detail: Access tokens last 1 hour and refresh tokens 14 days. Unused for 14 days, the user must redo authorization. Authorization codes last 1 minute.

traps.title: Authorizing user's permissions matter
traps.detail: If the authorizing user lacks in-app permissions, calls return HTTP 403. All list endpoints need a Site Admin.

traps.title: Scope changes go through Partner Support
traps.detail: Requesting scopes not permitted for your client gives an invalid_scope error.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A redirect_uri that differs from the registered one is rejected.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account', and quota is shared across Composio users.

blockers.what_it_means: The authorizing user lacks needed Greenhouse permissions.
blockers.what_to_do: Have a Site Admin or suitably permissioned user authorize.
